definitions.explanation: The act of imitating someone's voice, mannerisms, or appearance for entertainment. A popular form of comedy in Japan, where professional impersonators mimic celebrities on television shows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{物|もの}まね⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{物|もの}まね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{笑|わら}われた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: I did an impersonation of the company president at the year-end party and got laughs.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{物|もの}まね⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧になった⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many comedians became famous through impersonation shows on TV.

notes:
USAGE:
Can also be written as {物真似|ものまね} in kanji. Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb: {物|もの}まね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do an impersonation). The person who performs impersonations is called a {物|もの}まね⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧ or ものまね⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Impersonation comedy is a major genre in Japanese entertainment. TV shows dedicated to {物|もの}まね are popular, and annual {物|もの}まね contests draw large audiences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物|もの}まね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do an impersonation
- {物|もの}まね⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧: impersonation comedian
- {物|もの}まね⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: impersonation show
- {物|もの}まね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: good at impersonations
